movies.title: The General
movies.tagline: He loves two things: his train and his girl.
movies.description: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern train engineer chases it deep behind enemy lines in one of the great chase comedies.
movies.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Clyde Bruckman · Starring Buster Keaton · Marion Mack
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Sherlock Jr.
movies.tagline: A projectionist dreams his way into the movies.
movies.description: A small-town projectionist who dreams of being a detective falls asleep on the job and walks straight into the movie on screen.
movies.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Kathryn McGuire · Joe Keaton
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Safety Last!
movies.tagline: One man. Twelve stories. No net.
movies.description: A small-town go-getter promises his sweetheart he has made it big in the city, then has to climb the outside of a skyscraper to prove it.
movies.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Mildred Davis
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: The Freshman
movies.tagline: The most popular man on campus — in his own mind.
movies.description: An eager college newcomer tries to become the most popular man on campus and ends up the tackling dummy of the football team.
movies.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Jobyna Ralston
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: One Week
movies.tagline: Newlyweds. A build-it-yourself house. What could go wrong?
movies.description: Newlyweds try to assemble a build-it-yourself house in seven days, not knowing a jealous rival has swapped the numbers on the boxes.
movies.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Edward F. Cline · Starring Buster Keaton · Sybil Seely
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.tagline: The fastest-talking newsroom ever filmed.
movies.description: A fast-talking newspaper editor schemes to stop his star reporter, who is also his ex-wife, from quitting and remarrying by handing her one last big story.
movies.credits: Directed by Howard Hawks · Starring Cary Grant · Rosalind Russell · Ralph Bellamy
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.tagline: The original vampire. Still the scariest.
movies.description: A real-estate clerk travels to the Carpathians to close a sale with the reclusive Count, who then follows him home bringing plague and death.
movies.credits: Directed by F. W. Murnau · Starring Max Schreck · Gustav von Wangenheim · Greta Schröder
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: The Phantom of the Opera
movies.tagline: Beneath the opera house, someone is listening.
movies.description: A disfigured genius haunting the cellars beneath the Paris Opera grooms a young singer for stardom, and will kill anyone who stands in his way.
movies.credits: Directed by Rupert Julian · Starring Lon Chaney · Mary Philbin · Norman Kerry
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.tagline: They won't stay dead.
movies.description: Strangers barricade themselves inside a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in through the night.
movies.credits: Directed by George A. Romero · Starring Duane Jones · Judith O'Dea · Karl Hardman
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
movies.tagline: Feed me.
movies.description: A hapless florist's assistant breeds a strange plant that makes the shop famous, but it only thrives on human blood.
movies.credits: Directed by Roger Corman · Starring Jonathan Haze · Jackie Joseph · Mel Welles
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Carnival of Souls
movies.tagline: She walked away from the crash. Or did she?
movies.description: After surviving a car crash into a river, a church organist starts a new life in Utah but is stalked by a ghoulish figure and drawn to an abandoned pavilion.
movies.credits: Directed by Herk Harvey · Starring Candace Hilligoss · Sidney Berger · Frances Feist
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Metropolis
movies.tagline: The city of the future was built in 1927.
movies.description: In a towering future city split between idle rulers and underground workers, the ruler's son falls for a prophet of the workers, and an inventor builds a robot in her image.
movies.credits: Directed by Fritz Lang · Starring Brigitte Helm · Gustav Fröhlich · Alfred Abel
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: A Trip to the Moon
movies.tagline: The first science-fiction film ever made.
movies.description: A congress of astronomers fires itself to the moon in a giant shell, lands in the Man in the Moon's eye, and escapes the moon's strange inhabitants.
movies.credits: Directed by Georges Méliès · Starring Georges Méliès · Bleuette Bernon
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
movies.tagline: Young men, sold a glorious war.
movies.description: A class of German schoolboys enlists in the First World War full of patriotic fire and learns in the trenches what the war really costs.
movies.credits: Directed by Lewis Milestone · Starring Lew Ayres · Louis Wolheim · John Wray
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: D.O.A.
movies.tagline: A man reports his own murder.
movies.description: A small-town accountant learns he has been fatally poisoned and has only days left to find out who killed him, and why.
movies.credits: Directed by Rudolph Maté · Starring Edmond O'Brien · Pamela Britton · Luther Adler
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Man with a Movie Camera
movies.tagline: One day in the life of a city, told only in pictures.
movies.description: A cameraman roams Soviet cities from dawn to dusk in a wordless, restlessly inventive portrait of modern life and of filmmaking itself.
movies.credits: Directed by Dziga Vertov · Edited by Elizaveta Svilova · Starring Mikhail Kaufman
movies.license: Public domain in the United States

movies.title: Big Buck Bunny
movies.tagline: A gentle giant. Three very rude rodents.
movies.description: A gentle giant rabbit's sunny day is ruined by three bullying rodents, so he plans an elaborate cartoon revenge.
movies.credits: Directed by Sacha Goedegebure · Produced by Blender Foundation
movies.license: (c) copyright 2008, Blender Foundation / www.bigbuckbunny.org · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

movies.title: Sintel
movies.tagline: A girl, a dragon, and a search across the world.
movies.description: A lone young woman crosses a harsh fantasy world to find the baby dragon she rescued and raised, which was snatched away from her.
movies.credits: Directed by Colin Levy · Starring Halina Reijn · Thom Hoffman
movies.license: © copyright Blender Foundation | durian.blender.org · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.tagline: Amsterdam, the future, and a robot problem.
movies.description: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a band of scientists stages a desperate experiment to rewrite a painful breakup that set the machines loose.
movies.credits: Directed by Ian Hubert · Starring Derek de Lint · Sergio Hasselbaink · Vanja Rukavina · Denise Rebergen
movies.license: (CC) Blender Foundation | mango.blender.org · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

movies.title: Elephants Dream
movies.tagline: Two men inside a machine that makes no sense.
movies.description: Two men wander an endless, shifting machine world, the older one insisting he knows its rules while the younger begins to doubt him.
movies.credits: Directed by Bassam Kurdali · Starring Tygo Gernandt · Cas Jansen
movies.license: (c) copyright 2006, Blender Foundation / Netherlands Media Art Institute / www.elephantsdream.org · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/

movies.title: Cosmos Laundromat
movies.tagline: A suicidal sheep gets a second chance. And a third.
movies.description: On a desolate island, a despairing sheep named Franck meets a strange salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime, with a catch.
movies.credits: Directed by Mathieu Auvray · Starring Pierre Bokma · Reinout Scholten van Aschat
movies.license: (CC) Blender Foundation | gooseberry.blender.org · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

movies.title: Spring
movies.tagline: A shepherd girl and her dog face the spirits of winter.
movies.description: A shepherd girl and her dog face the ancient mountain spirits in order to keep the cycle of life turning.

movies.title: Sprite Fright
movies.tagline: Teenagers in the woods. Tiny, angry forest sprites.
movies.description: A group of rowdy teens on a woodland outing tangle with an eccentric nature lover and the adorable-looking mushroom sprites that guard the forest.
movies.credits: Directed by Matthew Luhn · Hjalti Hjálmarsson
movies.license: Sprite Fright by Blender Studio, © Blender Foundation | studio.blender.org, licensed CC BY 4.0 · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

movies.title: Charge
movies.tagline: One shot. Four minutes. No rules.
movies.description: In an energy-starved dystopia, an old man breaks into a battery factory and finds himself trapped with a deadly security droid.
movies.credits: Directed by Hjalti Hjálmarsson
